correctness.rationale: For any graph, derivative of \(s^{\mathsf T}(H+tB)^{-2}s\) equals minus \(y^{\mathsf T}[HB+BH+2tB^2]y\) with \(y=(H+tB)^{-2}s\); bijection on centered subspace proves the necessary and sufficient criterion, including constructive adverse profiles when indefinite. For the weighted 3-path Q annihilates the all-ones vector, has strictly positive trace, and has second characteristic coefficient \(3(Kuv-b^2u^2-a^2v^2)\), which yields exactly the closed root interval. Positive definiteness of B on centered vectors makes all positive-intensity inequalities strict. Each isolated edge has negative second coefficient. SymPy exact checker reproduced the general symbolic identities and explicit rational adverse derivative \(10/2197\).

value.rationale: A motivated multi-edge gap is explicitly stated by the 2022 same-model source. The finding gives the sharp all-strength, all-innate profile safety range on the smallest connected two-edge network; it reveals robust coordinated interventions that are safe despite each isolated link being unsafe, with a general test usable beyond three agents. Neither correctness alone nor a cherry-picked rational example drives its value.
